reason: workflow declares this stage approval: required
summary: Add private, persistent per-link click statistics using UTC click events, while preserving existing endpoint contracts and keeping redirect recording best-effort.
decisions: Click storage representation: Store one compact event row per click, containing only link id, clicked_at, and UTC click_date. (agent)
UTC daily aggregation: Persist a UTC-derived click_date alongside the UTC timestamp and aggregate on that indexed date. (agent)
Redirect recording: Perform a minimal synchronous insert and contain persistence failures rather than making recording asynchronous. (agent)
Stats route and authorization: Use GET /api/links/{code}/stats and the existing X-Management-Token convention, with the specified 401/403/404 distinctions. (agent)
Existing API contracts: Keep creation, redirect, metadata, and deletion request/response contracts unchanged; add only the stats subresource and deletion's internal analytics cleanup. (agent)
